cohort: Women who underwent caesarean section at the Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital from January 1, 2014 to December 31, 2014
finding: The caesarean section rate at the Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital was 24%, with the most common indications being previous caesarean section and cephalopelvic disproportion.
mod_finding: The study found that the cesarean section rate was 24%, with the most common indications being previous cesarean section and cephalopelvic disproportion.
